description: An older bearded man in a white turban and dark hooded robe sits cross-legged in a vaulted brick cellar lined with stacked books and chests. He writes with a reed pen on an open book on a carved wooden lectern. A brass astrolabe lies on the floor beside a sprig of dried herbs, and an oil lamp burns on a small wooden crate. No text or frame is visible; the image fills the square edge to edge.
